standard_prerequisites.name: Modifications of normal schemes are isomorphisms in codimension 1
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives f^{-1}(U) -> U an isomorphism once every closed point of U has codimension 1.

core_obligations: Recall U = Spec(A) \ {m} for the 2-dimensional Noetherian local domain A with U normal.
Check that every closed point u of U has codimension 1 in U: the only point of codimension 2 is the removed closed point m, so closed points of U are exactly the height-one primes.
Apply the modification-normal-iso-over-codimension-1 lemma to conclude f^{-1}(U) -> U is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Punctured spectrum setup; codimension-one computation for closed points; citation of the codimension-1 isomorphism lemma.
difficulty_reason: A short proof whose one substantive step is the reader-checkable codimension computation showing the hypothesis of the cited lemma holds on the punctured spectrum.
